description: Domain lookup over RDAP (the successor of WHOIS) and DNS: registered or available, registrar, creation, update and expiry dates, days until expiry, age, status codes, DNSSEC, name servers, plus whether it resolves (IPv4/IPv6) and its mail servers. Any TLD with an RDAP service; others are inferred from DNS. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
